reading.title: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
reading.summary: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

news.title: What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are
news.summary: President Trump says the "status quo" is what Gulf Arab allies want as the Iran war hits a stalemate and the U.S. midterms force a pivot from threats of attacks to economic pressure.
